scripts.build: npm run build -w @rift/shared && npm run build -w @rift/relay && npm run build -w @rift/agent && npm run build -w @rift/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @rift/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rift/relay && npm run typecheck -w @rift/agent && npm run typecheck -w @rift/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @rift/shared && node scripts/run-gates.mjs --test unit
scripts.test:boundary: npm run build -w @rift/shared && npm run build -w @rift/relay && node scripts/run-gates.mjs --test boundary
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-gates.mjs --test unit,boundary,architecture && npm run test:rust
